rationale: Build on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural edit: add learned per-tail-block anchor-refresh gates that progressively move the decoder anchor toward the running recurrent state before each reverse tail replay. This keeps the winning recurrence/quant-aware/export path intact, adds only a tiny control tensor budget, starts exactly at baseline behavior from zero init, and targets the still-promising anchor-variant category without another scalar-only sweep.
title: Learned Progressive Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh
